verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own site says its fetch capability converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown. That directly covers getting scraped content as markdown instead of raw HTML. The evidence is a single marketing-level line with no API reference or output examples. missing for 10: API/endpoint documentation for the markdown fetch option, evidence the markdown output is clean (boilerplate stripped), independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as clean markdown instead of raw HTML

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
